label: The basic estimate
subgoals: Treat every erroneous response stream as equally likely
Note that aliasing means the error signature is zero
Approximate the aliasing probability as two to the minus n

label: Sizing the signature
subgoals: Take log base 2 of one over the target
Round up for the signature length
Recognize X values as the real limit on BIST signatures

label: Escapes at volume
subgoals: Multiply defective dies by two to the minus n for expected escapes
Question the equal-likelihood model for structured errors
Use intermediate signatures to localize a failing pattern
